result.summary: Found 1 issue: a text rendering problem in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card where delivery information appears corrupted or misformatted.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under 'Popular right now', the delivery time text appears corrupted or misformatted. It displays as '25-350rdelivery' instead of properly spaced text like '25-350 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text rendering or spacing in the delivery time display. Ensure proper spacing between the time range, unit (min), and 'delivery' word. Verify the text content and CSS styling for this element.
